row.team_price_text: Basic: $89/mo per location (1 register), billed annually
row.evidence: Lightspeed's SSO article ('Available on Plus') connects Retail POS to an OpenID Connect identity provider and creates users from the identity token's claims; no SCIM endpoint is documented in the help centre or the X-Series API.
row.notes: Researched Lightspeed Commerce's main retail product, Retail POS (X-Series); the pricing page says its prices reflect X-Series. R-Series, Restaurant and eCom are separate product lines and were not researched. Plans are priced per location with one register included ($89/$149/$289 per month billed annually), so per-user fields are null. SSO is OIDC only (no SAML) and on Plus only; users are created JIT from the ID token, and in 'Access management' mode the IdP also supplies role and outlet. The X-Series REST API can list, read and delete users and kill their sessions, but has no create-user endpoint; personal tokens and 'API access' are Plus only, while OAuth apps (partners) are documented without a plan gate.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Pricing table markup ticks API access, Custom User Roles and SSO only in the Plus column; the SSO help article says 'Available on Plus'.

scim.notes: No SCIM in the X-Series help centre (search 'scim' returns nothing) or the X-Series API reference (llms.txt index); users are created from the OIDC ID token on SSO sign-in.

endpoints.purpose: Delete all sessions and personal tokens of a user

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhook docs list customer, inventory, product, register_closure and sale events; no user events seen.

rate_limits.text: Per retailer per application and per retailer for all users: 300 x registers + 50 requests per 5-minute window (350 for one register).

limitations.text: The users:write scope says it covers creating and updating users, but the API reference lists no create or update user endpoint.
Personal tokens are Plus only; OAuth 2.0 apps are documented without a plan restriction.

user_api.notes: API access is ticked only on Plus in the pricing table (read from markup); row api_tax reflects that.

entra.notes: No Entra gallery tutorial found at guessed Learn URLs.

fallbacks.notes: In 'Access management' mode the IdP also assigns role and outlet through ID-token claims at sign-in.
